wars.name: Alboury Ndiaye's wars
wars.outcome: May 1874: a major rebellion in Jolof, the alliance with Lat Jor defeated at Coki; 11 February 1875 Amadou Ba killed at Samba Sadio; September 1875 he drove off Bara Ba; 1881 he beat a rival claimant and Bara Ba at Jame Njay; 1886 he defeated the French-backed…

wars.name: French conquest of Jolof
wars.outcome: May 1890: Alfred Dodds's column marched on Yang-Yang; in July 1890 the French shelled Kaédi; Alboury fled east across the Ferlo to Futa Toro and Nioro and, with Ahmadu Tall's army, fought on 3 January 1891.

certainty.note: The page gives no post-1549 borders; the Louga region is a stand-in.
